changeSet.author: koala

preConditions.onFailMessage: Message report migration blocked: reconcile duplicate active reporter/message pairs before deployment.
preConditions.onErrorMessage: Message report migration could not verify active reporter/message uniqueness.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT reporter_id, message_id FROM reports WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false GROUP BY reporter_id, message_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicates

changeSet.sql: UPDATE reports r SET reported_user_id = m.sender_id FROM messages m WHERE r.message_id = m.id AND r.reported_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.sender_id
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_reports_active_reporter_message ON reports (reporter_id, message_id) WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false
